title: AgentCore Memory
hook: Managed short-term and long-term memory so agents remember across turns—and across sessions.

back.lead: Memory gives agents managed recall. Short-term memory captures raw session events—the conversation as it unfolds. Long-term memory applies extraction strategies to distill durable knowledge that persists across sessions.

kv.v: Built-in: semantic facts, summaries, and user preferences. A self-managed strategy (GA) lets you run your own extraction and consolidation pipeline.
Added at re:Invent 2025: per-user episodic memory for personal preferences (seat choice, budget caps, style).
Memory streaming (2026) reduces the lag between an event happening and it becoming retrievable.

back.hookline: Short-term = the transcript. Long-term = what a good assistant would write in their notebook afterward.
